results.name: Lateral Raises Dumbbell
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing your body.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your arms are parallel to the floor.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Do not raise the dumbbells higher than shoulder height to prevent shoulder strain.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the exercise.
Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
results.description: Lateral Raises Dumbbell is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Lateral Raises on Cable Machine
instructions: Stand with your right side facing the cable machine, feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to the low pulley and grasp the handle with your left hand, palm facing inward.
Raise the handle out to your side until your left arm is parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Slowly lower the handle back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to work the opposite arm.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles throughout the movement.
Exhale as you raise the handle and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Lateral Raises on Cable Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Laying Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench or the floor, holding a light weight in your top hand.
Start with your arm in front of your body.
Raise your arm up and out until it points toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Use a light weight.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
results.description: Laying Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Rear Shoulders.

results.name: Leaning Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand next to a lifting cage, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Grasp the lifting cage bar for support with your left hand and lean your body to the opposite side by extending your arm.
With your right arm hanging down, raise the dumbbell out to your side until your arm is parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbow and your palm facing down.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control. Complete the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; lift the dumbbell with control.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbow throughout the exercise.
results.description: Leaning Dumbbell Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Low Cable Overhead Flyes
instructions: Stand in the center of a cable machine with the pulleys set at the lowest position. Grasp the handles with each hand, palms facing up, and take a step forward to create tension in the cables.
Lean lightly forward and position your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and your arms extended slightly behind you.
Raise the handles up and together in a wide arc, bringing them to meet above your head, while keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder muscles at the top of the movement.
Exhale as you raise the handles and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Low Cable Overhead Flyes is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Biceps.

results.name: Lying Bench External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your arms extended out to the sides, your elbows bent at 90 degrees, and your forearms hanging off the sides of the bench, perpendicular to the floor in line with your head.
Rotate your shoulders to lift your forearms upward until they are vertical to the floor, maintaining the 90-degree angle at your elbows throughout the movement.
Slowly lower your forearms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged and your back flat against the bench to maintain stability.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Keep your elbows fixed at a 90-degree angle throughout the movement to isolate the shoulder rotation.
results.description: Lying Bench External Shoulder Rotation is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Lying Bench Internal Rotation Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your arms extended out to the sides, your elbows bent at 90 degrees, and your forearms hanging off the sides of the bench, perpendicular to the floor in line with your torso.
Rotate your shoulders to lift your forearms upward until they are vertical to the floor, maintaining the 90-degree angle at your elbows throughout the movement.
Slowly lower your forearms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged and your back flat against the bench to maintain stability.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Keep your elbows fixed at a 90-degree angle throughout the movement to isolate the shoulder rotation.
results.description: Lying Bench Internal Rotation Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Lying Lateral Raises Bodyweight
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended straight and your arms extended out to your sides, palms facing down.
Lift both arms straight upwards, keeping them in line with your shoulders. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Hold the top position for a second, feeling the contraction in your shoulder and upper back muscles.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on your joints.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to prevent discomfort or injury.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Lying Lateral Raises Bodyweight is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on the lateral raise machine with your feet flat on the floor and your back pressed firmly against the backrest. Adjust the seat height so that the pads rest against the outside of your upper arms.
Grasp the handles with both hands, keeping your elbows bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor and slowly lower your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise your arms and inhale as you lower them back down.
Use a moderate weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Machine Lateral Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Military Press Bodyweight
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms bent at the elbows, hands positioned at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Engage your shoulders and press your hands upward until your arms are fully extended above your head.
Hold the top position for a moment, feeling the contraction in your shoulder muscles.
Slowly lower your hands back to shoulder height with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe consistently, exhaling as you press your hands upward and inhaling as you lower them.
Keep your head aligned with your spine to prevent neck strain.
Avoid using momentum; focus on muscle strength to perform the movements.
results.description: Military Press Bodyweight is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.
